conviction_note: The news was genuinely good, so the fundamental read is an over-reaction, but the reaction function vetoes a positive number: 22.5x volume with the close pinned at the low of a 40%-to-minus-24% intraday reversal, a 15.4% ATR, a $47m-cash biotech that has just told the market it will run a Phase 2b/3 off an effective shelf, and 1.5m freely saleable crossover shares are all supply mechanisms that do not clear in one session, so I take the findings sum of -1.3 and push it to -2.8 on the volume and ATR conditionals the baseline supplies.
bar: Positive topline Phase 2 results for CUE-221 in chronic spontaneous urticaria, met primary endpoint at all three doses (HSS7=0 at week 12: 54%/53%/43% vs 11% placebo and 41% omalizumab), 8-K items 7.01/8.01/9.01 filed 2026-09-21 — https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1645460/000119312526396094/d21238d8k.htm

cause.label: clinical_or_binary_readout
cause.what_happened: Cue Biopharma released POSITIVE Phase 2 CUE-221 topline data in chronic spontaneous urticaria on Sunday 2026-09-20 and held an 8:00 a.m. ET call on 2026-09-21; the stock opened +3.9%, spiked to roughly +40% intraday and then collapsed to close -23.7% on 22.5x normal volume as a 50%-in-20-days run-up was unwound and buyers weighed a 145-patient China-only trial with 17-18 patient control arms, missing PK/IgE data and an obvious financing need.

evidence.claim: 8-K items 7.01/8.01/9.01 filed 2026-09-21 discloses the 2026-09-20 press release and the 8:00 a.m. ET 2026-09-21 conference call; primary endpoint HSS7=0 at week 12 dose-responsive and met at all dose levels, 54% at top dose vs 11% placebo.

Exhibit 99.1 press release: 4 mg/kg 54% (N=35), 2 mg/kg 53% (N=36), 1 mg/kg 43% (N=37), placebo 11% (N=18), omalizumab 300mg 41% (N=17, not statistically tested); UAS7=0 46% vs 29% for omalizumab; no treatment-related SAEs; trial run by Genesis Life Sciences in China; company plans Phase 2b/3 in CSU and Phase 2 in food allergy.

Contemporaneous wire coverage timestamped 09/21/2026 11:03 describes the stock plunging ~31% in early trading on positive data, attributing it to 'skepticism about the reliability of the Chinese trial data and the relatively modest margin of improvement over the established therapy'.
Issuer name confirmed as Cue Biopharma, Inc., CIK 1645460, SIC 2834 Pharmaceutical Preparations.

positioning_check: No squeeze fuel. FINRA/Nasdaq short interest at the 2026-08-31 settlement is 318,420 shares, days to cover 1.76, down 2.8% from the prior settlement (https://api.nasdaq.com/api/quote/CUE/short-interest?assetclass=stocks, published ~2026-09-10). Against 7,264,414 shares outstanding as of 2026-08-12 (10-Q cover, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1645460/000119312526352128/cue-20260630.htm) that is 4.4% of shares out, and the position pre-dates the fall by three weeks. On drop-day volume of roughly 3.0m shares ($99.8m on a ~$33 average price) the whole short book is a fifteenth of one session, so covering cannot move this tape. No option skew is available: the baseline reports options `unusable_chain` with a stale $5 ATM strike (pre-April-2026 reverse split) and no two-sided ATM legs, so the market makes no directional statement out loud here. Insider record is net selling $2.0m against $0.1m of buys over twelve months per the same wire.

findings.finding: Cue has ~$47m of cash left on my arithmetic ($17.4m at 2026-06-30 plus $49.8m July net private-placement proceeds, less a $6.7m/month operating burn) and on the same morning told the market it will run a Phase 2b/3 in CSU and a Phase 2 in food allergy off an already-effective S-3 — a raise into this volume is the obvious next corporate act, and it is what the wires said traders were pricing.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This issuer raises on every spike: $12.0m public offering Sept 2024 at $0.50, ~$20m April 2025, a $0.28 deal closing 2025-12-22, and $50m privately at $33.21 in July 2026 — four financings in 24 months. The baseline's own comparable-drop list shows 2025-12-19 (-21.64%) followed by -5.22% the next close, and that drop day is itself an ATM/offering-dated 8-K in the baseline's shelf probe.
findings.why_not_priced: The price has already given back the entire readout pop, so the market has priced the dilution RISK; what it has not priced is that the overhang keeps buyers out of the bid on day two, because nobody wants to own the last print before a deal is announced into an $100m-volume tape. If it had been priced as a done deal the stock would have closed nearer its pre-readout $37 level with a normal-volume tail, not at the session low on 22.5x volume with 41% of shares outstanding changing hands.
findings.independence: Contemporaneous wire copy attributes the intraday reversal to traders 'lock[ing] in gains and weigh[ing] funding risks' — https://www.ad-hoc-news.de/boerse/news/nebenwerte/cue-biopharma-stock-swings-after-positive-cue-221-phase-2-data-and/70149440

findings.finding: 1,505,570 shares held by Cormorant, Vivo Opportunity and Seligman from the July 2026 private placement at $33.21 have been freely saleable since the resale S-3 went effective on 2026-08-20 — about eight normal days of volume in a 7.26m-share company, and the collapse from roughly +40% intraday is exactly the shape of that paper being hit into strength.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The baseline's own comparable falls include 2026-04-21 (-21.18%) followed by a -24.63% next open and -13.43% next close, on the same pattern of unlocked supply meeting a thin register; across all eight comparable drops the up rate is 50% but the median is -0.42%.
findings.why_not_priced: The fall already reflects sellers who transacted; what it does not reflect is how much of this block is left. At $28.27 these holders are 15% BELOW their $33.21 basis, which is why I size this small and skewed rather than large — the urgency drops once the print is under cost. If this supply were exhausted the tape would have closed off the low with a volume taper into the bell instead of pinning the session low.
findings.independence: The underlying purchase agreement and share count are in the 2026-07-10 8-K items 1.01/3.02 — https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1645460/000119312526301052/d123955d8k.htm

findings.finding: The readout was objectively positive and beat the active comparator, and B. Riley published on 2026-09-21 reiterating Buy with an $83 target, saying it would accumulate and calling the missing pharmacokinetic and IgE data 'a timing artifact related to the trial design rather than a negative signal' — so the morning after carries a named sell-side defence rather than a downgrade.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This name bounces about half the time after a comparable fall: of the baseline's eight drops at or below -16.6%, four rose the next close (+5.88%, +5.33%, +9.03%, +4.38%) with a median absolute next-day move of 6.45%, so a positive-catalyst bounce of this size is inside its ordinary range.
findings.why_not_priced: The price moved during a single session's liquidation, before the overnight publication cycle; the part the move did not reflect is a reader who arrives on 2026-09-22 and sees 54% vs 41% against Xolair with no SAEs and a Buy at $83 against a $28 print. If this had been priced the close would not have been 24% below a day where the primary endpoint was met at every dose.
findings.independence: The endpoint numbers that the note rests on are in the issuer's own exhibit, not the analyst's summary — https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1645460/000119312526396094/d21238dex991.htm

outside_window.finding: A follow-on equity offering or ATM draw off the effective S-3 to fund the planned Phase 2b/3 CSU study and Phase 2 food-allergy study. No 424B5, ATM prospectus supplement or offering press release existed as of the drop-day close, so this is an overhang inside the window and a priced event after it; when it lands, the precedent set is a discounted deal.
CUE-102 in recurrent glioblastoma (NCT06917885) has a primary completion of 2027-01-31 and the CUE-101 neoadjuvant Phase 2 (NCT04852328) 2027-10-31 — no dated binary sits inside this window.

Any downgrade, coverage drop or estimate cut on 2026-09-21 — the only analyst action found is B. Riley reiterating Buy
A Nasdaq listing deficiency or index-deletion notice — the bid price is $28.27, listingcenter and the FTSE Russell notice board are unreachable from here, and no issuer 8-K names one
An Item 4.02 non-reliance or going-concern paragraph — both text probes return zero hits ever
A usable option chain or 25-delta skew — the chain is stale across the April 2026 reverse split (ATM strike $5 against a $28 spot) and has no two-sided ATM legs

baseline_tension: Everything I found agrees with the baseline's reaction function and disagrees with my own fundamental read: the 22.5x volume conditional (-2.44% next session), the 15.4% ATR that phase 0 names the best free ranker, the close pinned at the session low after an entirely intraday fall, and two dated supply mechanisms all point down, while the objectively positive data and the reiterated Buy point up — and this name's own history of comparable falls is a 50% coin flip with a 6.45% median absolute move, so the dispersion is far wider than the number I am emitting.
